== Acquisition ==
'''[[Signet of Capture]]'''
* [[Quansong Spiritspeak]] ([[Tahnnakai Temple (explorable area)]])

== Notes ==
* This skill creates a [[Spirit of Wanderlust]] that uses the [[Wanderlust (attack)|Wanderlust attack skill]].
* The spirit's attack inflicts 0 [[damage]], which is considered damage for the purposes of skills and effects that trigger when the target takes damage, such as [[Painful Bond]] or [[Spiritleech Aura]].
* The health loss this spirit receives can be recovered by [[Spirit Boon Strike]] or [[Blood Bond]].
* Combine with [[Earthbind]] to increase the duration of the knock down.
